```plato
    // The overlap of two rectangles (component-wise Max of mins, Min of maxs).
    // Disjoint operands yield the empty inverted encoding.
    IntersectionOfBounds(a: Bounds2D, b: Bounds2D): Bounds2D
        => (Point2D(a.Min.X.Max(b.Min.X), a.Min.Y.Max(b.Min.Y)),
            Point2D(a.Max.X.Min(b.Max.X), a.Max.Y.Min(b.Max.Y)));
```
